goal: Deliver a local, portable spec@1 artifact CLI that validates, atomically persists, retrieves, hashes, and reports the local Git state of canonical spec files.
architecture: Keep domain contracts in wisp-model, pinned schema loading and validation in wisp-schema, filesystem/Git-bound artifact operations in wisp-artifacts, and argument/output handling in wisp-cli. Moon defines the project graph and Just exposes the build/test/lint/format/audit/CI task surface. The CLI exchanges deterministic JSON and uses no derived database, code-intelligence service, or MCP transport. Fixtures exercise the same public CLI/library behavior against temporary workspaces.
tech_stack: Moon project graph and Just task runner

tasks.title: Bootstrap the workspace and stable domain contracts
steps: Create a resolver-3 Rust workspace with package metadata, shared lint policy, deny configuration, and the five crates named in WISP-001 AC-001.

Create Moon workspace/project configuration and a Just task surface modeled on the local Michi and Callisto conventions, with build, test, lint, format, format-check, audit, and CI-equivalent commands.
Define ArtifactId, ArtifactType::SpecV1, LocalArtifactState, validated artifact, artifact record, persistence receipt, and serializable error DTO contracts in wisp-model.
Use camino for public workspace-relative paths and thiserror for domain errors; keep models independent of CLI, Tokio, MCP, Monokl, Michi, and SQLite.
Add focused unit tests proving ArtifactId rejects empty, traversal-like, and path-separator values.

tasks.title: Pin and validate the spec@1 schema
steps: Copy the recorded agent-plugins spec@1 schema byte-for-byte into schemas/spec@1.json and record the source repository path, source revision, schema ID, and SHA-256 in schemas/PROVENANCE.md.
Embed the schema in wisp-schema at compile time and validate candidate serde_json values with a draft-2020-12 implementation.
Return typed invalid-JSON, schema-violation, and unsafe-ID errors without formatting them for a terminal.
Test valid candidate acceptance and malformed JSON, unknown-property, missing-required-property, and unsafe-ID rejection.
tasks.commit_message: feat(schema): pin and validate spec v1

tasks.title: Implement canonical spec persistence and retrieval
steps: Resolve every valid spec ID exclusively to docs/specs/<id>.json below a supplied workspace root and set spec_file_path to that relative path before serializing.
Write deterministic pretty JSON through a same-directory tempfile and atomic rename; calculate SHA-256 only from final bytes read from the target path.
On get, load raw bytes, parse and revalidate the artifact, calculate the same SHA-256, and classify the path as absent, uncommitted, or clean from local Git status without creating a commit.
Test successful persist/get round-trip, absent get, validation failure without target creation, write failure without partial target, and uncommitted classification.
tasks.commit_message: feat(artifacts): persist and retrieve canonical specs

tasks.title: Expose deterministic artifact CLI commands and fixture coverage
steps: Implement wisp artifact validate, persist, and get commands with --workspace and JSON output; map every library success and error to a stable serializable object and nonzero failure exit.
Add an initial wisp status command that reports the requested spec artifact local state without implying broader workflow support.
Exercise the public command behavior against fixture workspaces and snapshot only deterministic JSON fields.
Document the available first-slice commands, direct-JSON portability boundary, and explicit exclusions in the README.
